outline.heading: How the author's setup works: an owner-controlled stack on personal hardware

points.text: Real route example: Claude Code → LiteLLM → Cerebras gpt-oss-120b.
Hermes → LiteLLM with a fallback chain follows the same principle: Hermes dispatches work to executors (Claude Code, Codex), while the shared model gateway selects models.
The official Hermes repository is NousResearch/hermes-agent.
